I bought it to carry 3/4” plywood. Works great if you’re strong enough to carry a sheet of plywood with one hand. I personally think it’s easier to carry the ply from the bottom and tip it over onto your shoulder.
Bought this hydraulic punch to add conduits to electrical service boxes and transfer switches. Did a great job in these heavy walled cabinets. Works much better than a metal hole saw.
Good quality for the price, feels firm and controls are tight, thanks.

Acheté il y a 1 mois, excellent produit même en basse pression. J'ai repeint une moto de piste complète avec une peinture de qualité, très bon résultat! Les différents réglages offrent de nombreuses possibilité de voiles, le nettoyage complet du pistolet est très aisé, très satistfait. Je recommande
Articolo di buona qualità, utilissimo per realizzare una tavola a croce custom o abbimabile ad un pantografo
Ottimo il prodotto è come descritto il pacco molto accurato il tempo di consegna rapido arrivato il giorno prima della stima di consegna....complimenti e grazie alla prossima.
Excelente la atencion, entrega inmediata. Producto de alta calidad.

Kit di ottima fattura, ogni pezzo ben rifinito e non presenta nessuna imperfezione. Il pacco arrivato in breve tempo e in ottime condizioni nonostante il peso non trascurabile, i pezzi al suo interno erano ben protetti. Unico neo che nel kit non sono presenti i blocchi di trascinamento, comperati a parte per pochi euro. Prezzo imbattibile se confrontato con altri venditori. Consigliato!

Wow, this is a super high quality set of rails. Everything arrived packaged extremely well, no damage to any components. The steel of the rails is thick and strong, the linear bearings slide well, the bearing blocks are strong and correctly take the entire axial load.Some of the holes in the bearing blocks could have been cleared better of debris but anyone can fix that at home with a drill bit.Also on my set the longest ball screw didn't fit in any of the bearing block bearings, but this was easy to fix by putting the end of the ball screw in ice water and heating up the bearing with a hair dryer. Then it slipped right on!I'm using this to build my own CNC router and the linear motion components really form the basis of a good system. I don't think you're going to find a better value for your money than this set.EDIT: Well I built a router around these components and it's working very well. No complaints at all!
They are great. it just took shipping twice to everything. The first time rts were missing.
